order: All archived raw frames in recorded order; consume each complete four-frame group and each final partial group with two real RGB frames available.
reference: Existing frozen native reference build, history updated only at synthetic group boundaries and retained across archived episodes as in the existing benchmark.
profiling: One pass, cProfile only around the five components; per-component wall times include profiler overhead. Archive IO, pooling and digests are outside these component times but inside the loop wall time.
limitations: The archive is existing17471 ordinary raw data, not the18000+i full-chain benchmark trajectories.
A synthetic four-frame group can contain several archived requested actions; this is not native repeat4 execution.
No emulator, IPC, branches, restoration or online model inference is timed.
Profiler overhead and concurrent ARC3 load prevent interpreting these numbers as native full-chain throughput or a controlled speedup.
Scorer metrics are diagnostic outputs on existing development data, not a new calibration, gate or learner result.
No code correction, threshold change or repeat of a failed native run is authorized by this diagnostic result.
